chunks: "Deliver the creatures of God to me. I am the trusted messenger sent to you."

key_terms.عِبَادَ اللَّهِ: Servants of God / Creatures of God

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Deliver the servants of God to me' mean in Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In the context of the Meccan disbelievers' demand for a sign, this verse highlights the Prophet's role as an 'Amin' (trustworthy) messenger, emphasizing that his authority derives from divine trust rather than personal power. Shia exegesis often links this to the concept of 'Ahd' (covenant), viewing the Prophet as the reliable conduit of God's message to the 'Abd Allah' (servants of God), a term that can encompass the faithful or specifically refer to the Prophet himself as the ultimate servant. This assertion serves as a counter to the Quraysh's skepticism, reinforcing the reliability of the prophetic mission amidst the signs of the Day of Judgment.
